chunk_findings.detail: The lazy `from ..templates import _render_stdlib` was the only reason this fake stayed importable without Jinja2 (the deleted comment says so). It is now a module-level import, so `import ddflow.adapters.fakes.templates` loads `ddflow.adapters.templates` immediately. In an environment where Jinja2 is not installed, that import raises `ImportError` before `render` is ever called, which is the failure the deferred import existed to avoid.

chunk_findings.detail: The lazy `from ..templates import _render_stdlib` was the only reason this fake stayed importable without Jinja2 (the deleted comment says so). It is now a module-level import, so `import ddflow.adapters.fakes.templates` loads `ddflow.adapters.templates` immediately.
